verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
wake still folding on the shore
no one claims the water's memory

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
salt dries on the rope
someone coils it anyway
not knowing what for

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning gulls arrive late
circling the empty cleat

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the tide chart curls in someone's pocket
folded so many times
the numbers give way to soft blue

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
he reads it anyway by feel
knowing low water like an old address

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the door in his hands still opens
though the house behind it is long gone

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
he keeps the key on his ring anyway
weight of a room he still walks through at night

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
morning finds him testing the lock again
just to hear that small click hold

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
some mornings the click is enough
he sets his coffee down and calls that home

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
rain finds the old hinge and it sings
he lets the door stand open to the yard

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a wasp keeps trying the screen for a way in
he watches, lets it teach him something about wanting

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the fifth try, it finds the gap it missed before
he doesn't move to close it, just breathes out

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the yard keeps its own hours, unhurried
he counts nothing, just the light shifting on the fence

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a moth adds itself to the porch bulb's small congregation
he leaves the switch alone a little longer

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the wasp's shadow crosses the fence, then is gone
he lets the gap stay open, calls it evening
motifs: an open gap in a fence
